supersedes: v1/v2 configs and scope_freeze records retained; v1 omitted G metadata/three-replay cost rule; v2 corrected E1 but omitted P5 full stratum/terminal union replay count; v3 preserves both original criteria with explicit replay witness storage; online planning and learning core unchanged
physical_contract: unchanged p3-main-v3 physical v4/acceptance-v1; task goal [0.08,0,0], 5mm/3deg and measured low speeds for >=0.3s, max30s, retries0
data: unchanged 90 families, train60/validation30, original train3200/validation1600; no new collection required
learning: three seeds, K5, two lambda candidates, matched1000 additional updates/branch; nine training branches

E2.test_generation: P5-01 only; canonical initial pose/pusher identity disjoint from train/validation/previous development; outcomes never guide replacement
E2.normal_failures: retain timeout/planner_invalid/workspace and physics failures with original denominator; unresolved infrastructure blocks complete evaluation

E1.family_selection: first two final families by fixed ID in each stratum; selected before results
E1.snapshot_source: G actual E2 path before decision; full physical+task+actual previous action+G context+RNG; warm None shared; initial and later contact-capable prefix, actual regime reported not assumed
E1.missing_snapshot: record unavailable and stop E1 completion; no successful-family substitution
E1.future_rule: independent offline physical replay from same complete snapshot three times per candidate, shared by all seven model instances, not repeated separately by model; never fed into online planning
E1.cost_range_rule: preserve docs06: [min(J)-epsilon,max(J)+epsilon], epsilon=profile atol+rtol*max(abs(J)); overlap=>ranking INCONCLUSIVE, repeated validity changes=>investigate; keep all attempts/costs/denominators
E1.limits: N16 diagnostic set is smaller than v1 N32 and online N128; 12 snapshots are six independent families, no full-N optimality claim

E3: same S1/SK raw E1/E2 contrasts with other settings matched; no redundant physics benchmark

statistics.unit: family within stratum, common resample across models; seed averages first within each family plus each seed separately
statistics.limitations: four families per E2 stratum and two per E1 stratum; exploratory uncertainty, no power/equivalence or industrial population guarantee; intervals do not cover all training-seed variation

P4_development_resource_allowance.E1_selection: two development snapshots per stratum/regime by fixed source ID/tick declared in P4-03 before physical outcomes; previous development data only, final test not used
P4_development_resource_allowance.rule: failure replay and single-change hypotheses plus development E1; revise estimate before exceeding declared work/space; no future criterion removed

P5_replay_application_resource_allowance.original_selection_rule: for each method/learning seed, smallest episode ID per stratum plus smallest per observed termination type, union deduplicate; include both success and failure when observed
P5_replay_application_resource_allowance.existing_replay_record: all requested/applied commands, actual interval times, pre/post state10, task/holding/terminal/validity, candidate/prediction/selected hashes and maximum component differences at every action boundary; original complete raw+model/source/config hashes referenced, original files retained
P5_replay_application_resource_allowance.existing_replay_scope: comparison witness produced by actual controller rerun, not table regeneration; preserve existing profile0.1percent action-boundary max position/yaw/speed tolerance and same termination; do not claim every raw diagnostic byte or substep invariance from this witness
P5_replay_application_resource_allowance.witness_budget_basis: conservative observed nonraw/interval max with1.5 allowance; exact new witness schema and actual bytes/interval verified before P5 batch
P5_replay_application_resource_allowance.mismatch_policy: keep full raw executed prefix on mismatch/physics error; 0.25GiB initial allowance, if insufficient stop and reestimate without dropping cases/relaxing criteria; P5-04 incomplete until all required reruns resolved
P5_replay_application_resource_allowance.new_initial_condition: one separate same-range initial family, full raw for all eight controllers; predeclared expected effect/changes/result, not OOD/new task

storage.multiplier_is: planning allowance, not measured worst-case bound
storage.new_recording: all original StepResult fields and initial snapshot compressed losslessly, all applied/requested commands and raw substeps retained; every plan compact replay inputs/hash and predeclared full snapshots/invalid trace
storage.guard: before each stage remeasure free disk and actual bytes/interval; minimum free2GiB; exceed estimate => preserve prefix and revise scope before continuing

time.excluded_or_uncertain: new E1 implementation/labels, P4 formal validation/checkpoints/audit, setup/load/bootstrap/report and retries; no guaranteed completion date or device real-time claim

measured_device_scope.cpu: local arm64 CPU; Torch1; BLAS threads unmeasured
measured_device_scope.other_M1_M4: not separately measured; one small replay/training timing on the destination device before extrapolating

budget: no paid service/cloud/equipment; additional monetary spending0; under100000KRW scope
